name: @curlew/omemo
description: OMEMO (XEP-0384) core: X3DH, the Double Ratchet, libsignal's legacy wire format and the AES-GCM payload cipher of `eu.siacs.conversations.axolotl`, plus the storage port the sessions live behind.
